item.title: File Copying and Remote Transfer in Restricted Environments
item.description: 📢 This article was translated by gemini-3.5-flash Ever since I learned about the scp command, I have rarely used FTP services or other strange workarounds to transfer files from my local machine to a server. However, recently I needed to transfer a relatively large file. Because the transfer time was long and I was afraid of corruption due to interruption, I started looking for other solutions.
